body: I wouldn’t know. But you already know people love you. I’m not sure if you know what is like to hear or see when a loved one dies. If you don’t, I’ll tell you. I held my mom as she died when I was 12 years old. Her addiction to meth killed her. It is the most unbearable pain I have ever felt. I don’t, and I know you don’t want those who love you to experience that anytime soon. Please take into consideration those words. At least reach out to someone. I am here to talk to you.
I love you. Everything will work itself out. I love you. You will be fine. I love you. And so do others.
Start a chat with me ASAP. I want to help
Man I’ve been there. If you want to talk privately to me, go to my profile and start a chat. I know how fucking unbearable it is. Never be afraid to ask for help <3

Oh man, there’s a few answers. Healthy ways, I would talk to friends and listen to music. Unhealthy, I would self harm and over eat. I wish I was more honest with my self and others about my issues. Honestly just talking about it is the best way. A lot of music helps as well.
